type: Fully automatic CNC pocket welting machine (Quick Reorder type) with X/Y servo axes and laser marker
source: J6 Quick Reorder PocketWelting Machine Operation Manual V01-8 (41-page PDF; manual pages 1-37 available; Chapters 5-6 not present in this PDF)
note: The J6 is a CNC template machine, not a standard lockstitch machine. Its 'parameters' are bag geometry values (mm dimensions) rather than electronic control parameters in the traditional sense. Pattern files are saved with names and numbers and loaded via RFID or barcode.

specs.axes: X axis (horizontal), Y axis (longitudinal), Z axis (servo spindle)
specs.laserMarker: Integrated laser for bag opening marking/positioning
specs.steamCylinder: Steam ironing cylinder for bag forming
specs.patternStorage: On-board flash memory; USB import/export supported

TrueFalseBag.description: Standard double-layer pocket welting pattern. Bag opening with noose/zipper or without. Primary pattern type.

parameters.H: MH/H Speed Offset Len — lateral distance for medium-to-high speed transition (0-100mm)

MoonToothBag.description: Moon-tooth shaped pocket welting pattern with curved bag mouth.
MoonToothBag.parameters: Similar parameter set to TrueFalseBag with geometry specific to curved pattern

openBagDesignTemplates.name: Seamless Seal Glue (Semi-Circle)

parameters.FR: Laser end point to right length
parameters.V1: Laser Point To Ring Hight — height of laser point from ring (0.0-999.9mm)
parameters.V2: Two Ring Len — longitudinal distance between laser ring and sewing ring (0.0-999.9mm)

openBagDesignTemplates.name: Circle Twice Sew
openBagDesignTemplates.description: Double-pass circular pocket sewing with dual laser endpoints

parameters.LD: Laser End Point To Left Len — lateral distance of end point of left laser (0-100mm)
parameters.RD: Laser End Point To Right Len — lateral distance of end point of right laser (0-100mm)

parameters.FD: Code To Left Down Len — horizontal distance from code to bottom left corner (0-100mm)

parameters.SL: Sew Point To Left Len (left) — horizontal distance from sewing point to left end (0-100mm)
parameters.W: Sew Width Space (rightup) — horizontal distance of sewing width interval top right (0-100mm)
parameters.V: Sew Width Space (rightup) — longitudinal distance of sewing height interval top right (0-100mm)

laserMiddleSet.description: Sets the shape of the intermediate laser marking between bag sections

parameters.Laser Middle Offset: Lateral offset of the center laser line

parameterDefinitions.A: Represents the length of the pocket
parameterDefinitions.B: Represents the width of the pocket
parameterDefinitions.C: Distance between the laser and the width edge of the fabric; larger value = laser farther from fabric
parameterDefinitions.D: Distance between the laser and the upper/lower edges of the fabric
parameterDefinitions.FR: Distance from the code to the right edge
parameterDefinitions.H: Distance from the code to the right edge
parameterDefinitions.V: Distance between the laser and the long edge of the fabric; larger value = laser farther from fabric

deviceDetect.description: Device detection and diagnostic functions. Access from menu → Device detect.

functions.name: Led Detection
functions.description: LCD screen detection — start/stop screen detection and set detection time. Range 0.5-24 hours.

functions.name: Panel Detection
functions.description: Touchscreen calibration — follow cursor and click to calibrate touchscreen step by step.

functions.name: Input Detection
functions.description: View ON/OFF status of all input signals to confirm correct signal reception.
inputSignals: IN7 — Laser lift plate in place
IN8 — Unload lift plate in place

functions.name: Output Detection
functions.description: Test ON/OFF state of all output signals to confirm correct signal delivery.

functions.name: XY Step Motor Test
functions.description: Enter XY origin detection interface to adjust XY axis click position and switches. Displays X position, Y position, X sensor status, Y sensor status, and origin offset (X/Y). Controls: Big Clamp, Small Clamp, X enable, Y enable.

functions.name: Servo Test
functions.description: Main spindle motor speed detection and debugging. Set target speed (RPM), view actual speed, control start/stop/reset. Alarm displayed if set speed exceeds safety range.

functions.name: Servo Angle Detection
functions.description: Main spindle motor installation angle calibration. Displays electric value, mechanical value, needle bar highest position, take-up lever highest position. Use Servo Motor Free to release motor for manual adjustment.
procedure: Install sensor on spindle and set reference point
Click 'Servo Motor Free' to release motor for free movement
Rotate main spindle to specific angle and read position data
Calibrate displayed values against actual position
Click 'Main Spindle Motor Lock' after adjustment
Verify all parameters are within tolerance

functions.name: Continuous Run Detection
functions.description: Run automated continuous operation testing. Settings: Repeated interval (×100ms, 0-99), Home detection (0-2), Cycle count (0-9999).

functions.name: Network Setting
functions.description: Configure wireless network for remote control functionality.

functions.name: Laser Offset
functions.description: Adjust laser coordinates relative to needle coordinates. Set the offset amount to align laser mark with sewing position.

createPattern: 1. Select the bag opening template from the opening-bag design interface.
2. Set corresponding values for needle spacing, length, width, etc. Use page turning button to modify other data items.
3. Click the preview button to enter the graphic preview interface. Click to exit.
4. Click Settings and adjust the XY position value of the pattern alignment point through the steering wheel.
5. Click OK to save the pattern.
6. Click OK on the write-mode dialog.
7. Set the name and number, click OK.
8. Pattern is now saved and displayed on main interface.
modifyPattern: 1. Enter modification mode from main interface (button P) or sewing interface (button O).
2. Select the laser type (Type1-Type5) and stitch type (Type1-Type5).
3. Select sewing type: Once or Twice.
4. Set graphic data such as backstitch count and starting stitch count.
5. Click Settings and use directional pad to adjust pattern alignment to target XY position.
7. Set name and number, click OK to save.
operations.xyOriginSetup: From main interface, press XY Origin button (D). Adjust X/Y position using directional keys. Save origin offset using Clear and Save buttons.

troubleshooting.issue: Laser not firing or misaligned with sewing path
troubleshooting.cause: Laser offset not calibrated, or laser output IO not configured
troubleshooting.solution: Use Device Detect → Laser Offset to adjust laser vs needle coordinate offset. Verify OUT1 (Laser) output is active using Output Detection.

troubleshooting.issue: XY axes not returning to origin
troubleshooting.cause: Origin sensors not detecting correctly, or XY offset set incorrectly
troubleshooting.solution: Use Device Detect → XY Step Motor Test to verify X sensor and Y sensor status. If sensors show OFF when frame is at origin, adjust sensor position mechanically.

troubleshooting.issue: Pattern not sewing correctly / stitches misaligned
troubleshooting.cause: Pattern parameters (A/B/C/D) set incorrectly, or XY origin not set
troubleshooting.solution: 1) Verify XY origin is set correctly. 2) Check pattern A (length) and B (width) values against actual fabric measurements. 3) Use Modification Mode preview to verify pattern shape before sewing.

troubleshooting.cause: Thread tension too high, speed too high for material, or thread sensor triggering false halt
troubleshooting.solution: Use sewing interface button P to adjust thread tension. Reduce sewing speed using interface button A. Check Thread sensor status in Input Detection.

troubleshooting.cause: Clamp solenoid fault or MAIN_OUT_FU not outputting
troubleshooting.solution: Use Device Detect → Output Detection to manually test MAIN_OUT_FU (Clamp) output. If output is OK but clamp doesn't engage, check solenoid or air pressure.

troubleshooting.issue: Bag cloth not reaching origin position
troubleshooting.cause: Bag cloth motor origin sensor (IN9) not detecting correctly
troubleshooting.solution: Use Device Detect → Input Detection to verify IN9 (Bag cloth Motor origin) status changes when motor reaches home position. Adjust sensor position if needed.

troubleshooting.cause: OUT7 (Steam cylinder) output not configured or solenoid fault
troubleshooting.solution: Test OUT7 using Output Detection. Check steam cylinder solenoid and air pressure.
